english_draft: Broadcom (AVGO) published its FY2026 Q3 report on 2026-09-02 for the quarter ended 2026-08-02. Revenue was about USD 29.6 billion, up 86% year over year. AI semiconductor revenue was USD 16.7 billion, up 221% year over year. GAAP operating income was USD 16.0 billion. Non-GAAP operating income was USD 20.1 billion. Operating cash flow was USD 14.2 billion. Capital expenditure was USD 0.5 billion. Free cash flow was USD 13.7 billion. Management guided FY2026 Q4 revenue to about USD 34.8 billion. Management guided Q4 AI semiconductor revenue to USD 21.7 billion. The next earnings event is estimated for 2026-12-09. A reliable consensus estimate is not available in the provided sources. The main question is whether AI semiconductor revenue meets the company guidance. The second question is whether the growth is broad-based or concentrated in few customers. The third question is whether free cash flow remains close to net income. A positive surprise would be AI revenue above USD 21.7 billion. A negative surprise would be lower AI revenue or a margin decline. Verification points are the exact GAAP and non-GAAP margin and the cash flow statement.
